question: What do iPhone XR reviewers say about battery life?
answer:
One reviewer was pleased that the iPhone XR arrived with battery life at 100%. [b0c1f95adb9c_0]
Another reviewer said the battery life was low but still above 85%, which they considered okay. [6f1fc1c01893_0]
A reviewer complained that their iPhone XR's battery maximum capacity was lower than their old XR that had been in heavy daily use for four years. [2fd1446e5543_0]
A reviewer reported battery life and overheating problems about four weeks after purchase. [0e8733716715_0]
Other reviewers said the battery life was a turn-off at 75%, that it needs charging more often than it should, and that it runs down fast at 86% health. [c783005fbabc_0] [147314ca0eb4_0] [bc349adb9dc2_0]

I almost didn’t buy because I always read one star reviews just to see if everyone has the same complaint but I’m so glad I looked past those and just bought it.
